title: Washington tribe's salmon returns surge from hundreds to over 13,000
summary_full: The Puyallup Tribe's salmon hatchery in Washington has grown from recording a few hundred returning fish in 2005 to more than 13,000 Chinook and coho in 2026. The programme has also begun supplying eggs to another tribe, while new facilities are being built to expand fish-handling capacity
